headline: Google says schools that disable AI tools must also give up Search
summary: Google says schools that choose to disable its AI tools will also lose access to Google Search, since AI features are now built into the search engine, making it impossible to use Search without AI. The company announced new AI products for classrooms on Tuesday, along with tools letting teachers and schools limit AI use, which it says don't give away the answers.
